original_test_intent: The item appears intended to verify that the standalone BIOS Discard Changes action removes one pending edit without invoking the adjacent Exit or Reset operations, but the source Criteria instead require the setting to be saved.
original_method: The generic Procedure asks the operator to exercise Discard Changes and collect evidence; the item implies non-persistence of a pending edit, whereas the preserved Criteria define successful persistence.
manual_activity: After source correction, a human must create the approved pending BIOS edit, invoke the standalone Discard Changes control and observe the result. No manual operation is authorized while save and discard remain opposite candidate PASS conditions.
required_inputs: Owner-corrected operation and expected persistence state
safety_requirements: Do not infer whether Items or Criteria are authoritative.
Do not change, save or discard a BIOS value until the acceptance state is corrected.
After correction, limit the operation to one reversible approved field.
Avoid boot/storage/security/management fields unless separately approved.
Stop on unintended NVRAM delta or loss of boot/management access.
agent_execution_scope: Preserve the conflict and collect read-only identity, baseline and supporting health evidence after correction.
Compare operator captures against the corrected expected state.
Do not operate BIOS, substitute a software variable write or decide PASS/FAIL.
engineer_actions: Choose and approve the authoritative operation and expected persistence state.
After correction, approve the field, recovery and evidence method and perform the BIOS action.
Determine the formal verdict from corrected evidence.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Its rejection of agent-driven BIOS UI is sound, but its assumed non-persistence contradicts the preserved Criteria and therefore cannot authorize execution.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Remain blocked until the source is corrected; then retain the exact standalone BIOS control rather than replacing it with a software write, Exit, Reset or reboot sequence.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: Generic Discard Changes, no-script state and 5/5-minute fields are preserved.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: After the owner aligns the operation and Criteria, trace baseline, pending edit, exact standalone control, immediate state and final restoration. If discard remains authoritative, the edited value must be absent; if save is intended, rename and revise the case before execution.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: Exact BIOS Save & Exit page implementation after correction.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Platform control semantics and owner correction.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds an explicit state transition and forbids selecting between contradictory acceptance outcomes.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: No coverage is removed; execution is deferred until the intended function has one coherent PASS state.
modernized_recommendation.required_inputs: Corrected source intent plus named field and documented control behavior.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Evidence cannot validate both persistence and non-persistence for the same action.

project_override_considerations: A project may choose the safe field and verification method after correction, but it cannot override the Master Source contradiction silently or report completion against both opposite states.
expected_evidence: Owner correction identifying the authoritative action and expected persistence
Platform identity, approved field/value, baseline and recovery
After correction, pending-edit and exact-control captures
Restored final state, health and engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Items name Discard Changes, whose essential result is removal of pending edits, while Criteria require that the setting can be saved. Those are opposite persistence outcomes for the same standalone control.

blocked_analysis.analysis: This is not a missing project parameter: the required PASS state is semantically contradictory. Executing would force the reviewer to invent which source statement wins.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Retains its manual UI boundary but rejects its unapproved choice of non-persistence as sufficient while Criteria say saved.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Agrees that owner correction is required and preserves its recovery/evidence boundaries.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.v3_1_improvement: Separates this standalone control from the Exit and Reset variants and records a case-specific decision rather than a global BIOS rule.

review_improvement: Prevents a false verdict based on selecting either save or discard opportunistically and preserves the unique standalone-control scope.
independent_technical_reasoning: A single pending value cannot simultaneously be discarded and saved. Because that contradiction determines the core acceptance behavior, the case is genuinely BLOCKED before the otherwise manual BIOS activity can be classified for execution.
no_automatic_retry: Do not perform or repeat any BIOS operation while the acceptance conflict remains; after correction, preserve the first result and obtain engineer disposition before any retry.
